MPESB Group 3 Exam Syllabus 2026

Part Subject Marks Details
Part A General Knowledge 100 Marks General subjects including General Knowledge, Hindi, English, Mathematics, Reasoning, General Science and Computer Knowledge.
General Hindi
General English
Mathematics
Reasoning Ability
General Science
Computer Knowledge
Part B Technical Subject 100 Marks Questions related to the technical subject prescribed for the candidate's respective post code.
Total 200 Marks Complete Examination

Technical Subject and Paper Code

Paper Code Technical Subject Applicable Post Codes
A Electrical Engineering 003, 007, 010, 015, 019, 021, 026, 029, 040, 044, 048, 058, 067, 078, 087, 094, 104, 106, 109, 116, 117, 119, 128**, 131**
B Mechanical Engineering 004, 008, 014, 024, 025, 030, 038, 053, 055, 061, 070, 073, 075, 077, 095, 097, 101, 103, 107, 118, 128**, 131**

D Computer Science and Engineering 006, 011, 017, 028, 031, 033, 042, 050, 059, 064, 080, 098, 112, 115

Note: The technical subject is determined by the post code. Candidates should check the official rulebook for the complete subject-wise syllabus and applicable post codes before starting their preparation.
